residualUnknowns: Original notice/RFP, original award or signed contract and all corrigenda
Whether listing/detailed dates encode publication, contract signature or another event; actual timezone
Tender-specific procedure approval and any justified sole-source or limited invitation
Currency, GST basis, scope/term, licence/revenue direction and actual receipts/payments
Delivery, commissioning, service performance and completion certificates
Verified supplier legal identity or decision-specific political involvement
restrictionsObserved: No captcha bypass, login or authentication workaround
No supplier/politician identification or misconduct label
No geographic interpolation or finding that absence of a link means absence of corrigenda
No same-title or unmatched-ID search result substituted for a selected case
limitations: This is a purposive seven-case review, not a random sample or corpus-wide error-rate estimate.
The five raw detail extractions and the two parallel original fetches have distinct denominators.
The older listing-only 1,714-pair equality result has a different, heavily Neyveli 2013–18 population; its rate must not be assigned to this sample or the full corpus.
The IRCTC comparison differs in train/service scope and exact date; it is not proof of normality or an outcome benchmark.
procedureFieldLineage: The lead tender_type field is derived from notice_details by the extraction pipeline; it is not a separate raw notice-listing procedure column.
